# llm-d Prism

!!! info "BLIS binaries these results describe"
    - `(devel)+9e3c509c8788fe0743605a8f06e0bf5c1c39ac1f`, binary sha256 `29fb09054a10ee51dc104f491cb09337e0ba527055b85653d281f23230451dff`

Public llm-d benchmark results ([llm-d-prism](https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d-prism) and the `gs://llm-d-benchmarks` bucket) for models in blis-catalog, replayed by BLIS.

Signed error `100 * (BLIS / measured - 1)`: positive means BLIS is higher (slower latency, or more throughput). Geo-mean bias is `100 * (exp(mean log ratio) - 1)`.

## Provenance verdict

**No Prism run is EXACT** (0 EXACT anchors). Every run on a catalog model leaves material settings unstated (vLLM version, serve args, router config, offload size) with no run artifact that resolves them, so each anchor is PARTIAL (the source analysis calls it APPROXIMATE).

### A1: PARTIAL

Llama-3.1-70B on H100, standalone vLLM (14 replica x TP configs, concurrency 1 to 256, random 10000/1000).

Source: [llm-d-prism](https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d-prism/blob/6769be260f44/public/data/archive/llmd_results/llm-d-benchmarks.json) archive at `6769be260f44`; serve args from [llm-d-benchmark](https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d-benchmark/tree/58b2d1b) `58b2d1b`.

- vLLM image `vllm-openai:latest` on the run dates (v0.10.1.1 or v0.10.2); BLIS prices v0.31.0 behaviour
- serve args reconstructed from the benchmark repo plus vLLM v0.10.2 defaults; the replica x TP treatment list is in no commit
- routing is a Kubernetes Service (connection-level random); BLIS uses round-robin
- the archive keeps no p90 and no per-request data; output tok/s is derived from the request rate

### A2: PARTIAL

Llama-3.1-70B on H100, P/D through llm-d (5 prefill/decode layouts), as recorded (disaggregated).

Source: same archive; [llm-d-benchmark](https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d-benchmark/tree/e98acd0) `e98acd0`.

- all of A1's differences
- llm-d image tag `auto` (vLLM version unknown); gpu-memory-utilization not passed
- router `plugins-v2.yaml` on inference-scheduler v0.2.1, which BLIS's EPP config cannot ingest, with no P/D profile handler
- NIXL over TCP; BLIS uses a nominal 100GbE fabric; BLIS pools cannot share a node

### A2': PARTIAL

The same P/D runs modelled as colocated replicas (hypothesis: the measured runs did not disaggregate).

Source: same as A2.

- all of A2's differences
- the mixed-TP layout is omitted

### B: PARTIAL

Llama-3.3-70B on H100, 4 x TP4, shared-prefix 30k/50k/70k at concurrency 20, with prefix-cache offloading.

Source: 7 curated reports in the public bucket `gs://llm-d-benchmarks/prefix-cache-offloading/`.

- model graph is Llama-3.1-70B's (architecture-identical config)
- LMCache and llm-d-fs offload are not modelled; the CPU tier size is unstated
- the EPP plugin config is unstated, so two BLIS routings bracket it
- vLLM version unknown (llm-d-cuda v0.5.1/v0.6.0); the input length is the measured mean

**What would make a run EXACT:** the vLLM version, serve args and router config recorded with the run, an EPP version BLIS can ingest, and (for B) an offload connector BLIS models with its CPU tier size stated.
